2. Setting this equal to 1/4 and dividing by x²/4 gives 2 ln x−1=0.

prompt: Consider a binary tree T in which every node has either zero or two children. Let n > 0 be the number of nodes in T . Which ONE of the following is the number of nodes in T that have exactly two children ?
